d: Israel votes tomorrow in an election widely seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his security-first leadership. US President Donald Trump has endorsed Netanyahu and urged Israelis to support him, while large anti-government protests have demanded accountability over the October 7 attacks and the wars that followed. Netanyahu is doubling down on his image as “Mr Security”, warning of threats from Iran and its proxies and saying only his leadership can keep Israel safe.
